text: その　へんの　やつ　から　むりやり　とって　きたぜ！

structure.jp: その　へんの　やつ　から
むりやり　とって　きたぜ！
structure.en: I took it by force and came back!

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after the て-form of a verb says you did it somewhere and then came here. とって きた = 'took it and came back'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end of a sentence is rough, boastful male speech. とって きたぜ = 'I went and took it!'
